Reward safety: total reward is bounded (at most two rings, so at most 0.5 in silencing bonuses plus the 1.0 terminal), the uncontrollable ring event is not rewarded, no timeout reward exists, and the box propositions (holding_box, box_fell), which are irrelevant to this task, are absorbed by the per-state else self-loops as required. No defects found.
